role.roleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform

evidence.text: Managed the platform's three AWS accounts, quota requests and the tagging policy for the telephony and chat services, keeping the resource inventory current in the CMDB after each change window.

Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.

Ran the monthly capacity and cost review with the platform lead, proposing right-sizing of the chat-service instances with the expected monthly saving and the rollback path documented in the change record.
Wrote the post-incident review for the June outage, including the timeline, the missed capacity alarm and the follow-up actions, which the platform lead approved and the operations team accepted.
Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.

Work sample: the June outage post-incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and the chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with the ticketing system's audit history as a verification trail.
